_comment: CURATED+VERIFIED exaltation map. Source: RealmEye /wiki/exaltation per-stat lists, cross-checked against each dungeon's own wiki page (Kogbold->Vit, Fungal->Wis, Crystal->Wis, Nest->Dex confirmed 2026-06). Completing an exalt dungeon on an 8/8 character banks progress; milestones give PERMANENT, per-class stat bonuses. 'efficiency' = community consensus on fame/exalt-per-hour (high = grind these; low = run for loot/completion, not as a grind). Edit freely as the game changes.
_milestoneNote: 5/10/15/20/25 completions of a given dungeon = +1/+2/+3/+4/+5 to its stat(s); Life & Mana give 5x (max +25). Per class, permanent.

the-nest.note: Killer Bee Queen -> Dexterity. Fast & repeatable; Advanced Nest gives +90% XP. The go-to Dex exalt grind.

ice-cave.note: Esben the Neurotic -> Speed. Quick, low-risk Speed exalt + good fame.

kogbold-steamworks.note: Factory Control Core -> Vitality. Dangerous but fast; also rains greater pots. Best Vit exalt.

fungal-cavern.note: Crystal Worm Mother -> Wisdom. Greater pots of all 6 + Life pots + heavy white-bag UTs.

crystal-cavern.note: Crystal Entity -> Wisdom. Easter seasonal. Greater pots of all 6 + Life.

lost-halls.note: Marble Colossus -> Defense. Gateway to Cultist Hideout (Speed) and The Void (Mana/Def).

cultist-hideout.note: Malus -> Speed. Opened from inside Lost Halls.

the-void.note: Void Entity -> Mana; consuming a Vial of Pure Darkness -> Defense. Top difficulty, opened from Lost Halls.

moonlight-village.note: Last dancer decides the stat: Sage Genji -> Life, Drummer Kaguya -> Mana, Dancer Miko -> Attack.

the-shatters.note: Twilight Archmage -> Attack; The Forgotten King -> Life + Mana. Long & dangerous — run for completion/loot, not as a fame/exalt grind.

oryx-sanctuary.note: Oryx 3 -> Life. Very time-consuming; run for loot/exaltation completion, not as a fame grind.
